notes: Transcribed from the Tanoshii "TV mimikara N3" PDF flashcard book (880 words across 12 lessons/"bai").

280 of 880 words additionally have an example sentence merged in (by shared stt numbering) from the separate "280 Dong tu N3 cach nho" PDF, which only covers the verb-lesson subset of this word list; 187 of those also have mnemonic text (the source book leaves mnemonic blank for some entries, keeping only the example).
